scale.method: Manual reviewer judgment, not a benchmark or an arithmetic test-pass score.

scope: Six offline demo families on one OnePlus6 portrait configuration. Scores assess actual rendered card/app components; explicit gallery test chrome is excluded from component scores but considered in whole-screen usability limitations.

mail.rationale: Clear sender/subject and action hierarchy; native keyboard/draft/local-queue behavior has separate evidence. Expanded layout remains somewhat spacious.

calendar.rationale: Readable event hierarchy and selected RSVP; round10 corrects retained list offset on detail navigation and preserves per-event responses. Agenda rows remain tall.

news.rationale: Glance is substantially shorter; selected Feed/Saved and link-only copy are clear. Long titles consume more space than other families.

finance.rationale: Stacked names/prices eliminate prior horizontal truncation; watch/detail controls are reachable. Tall rows reduce density; charts and prices are fixture-only.

photo.rationale: Unavailable-image state is concise and honest, with clear Favorite/back controls. No actual image presentation was demonstrated; full app remains a sparse metadata list.

youtube.rationale: False Play affordance and header overflow are removed; Watch later and selected tabs are clear. No playback was demonstrated; full app remains a sparse metadata list.

strengths: Consistent panels, typography, rounded controls and family accents.
All six exported L0 glances rendered at 968px width with settled:true; no visible horizontal truncation in reviewed final glances.
Selected tabs/RSVP are visible; unsupported network/media actions are described honestly.
Final native list-scroll captures reach and open the last Calendar, Finance, Photo and YouTube items.
remaining_polish: Large primary glance buttons dominate the content; smaller secondary glance chips do not have independent 44pt compliance evidence.
Generous row spacing and prominent gallery controls consume substantial phone height; the whole L2 experience is less polished than individual cards.
Photo and YouTube demonstrate unavailable-media states only, not complete media app experiences.

calendar_regression.classification: Reviewed images show ordinary vertical list viewport clipping. Detail header/date/place are visible after last-item navigation; this fixes the distinct earlier retained-offset defect.
calendar_regression.implementation_note: stage.on_render creates a fresh ScrollYView subtree. Both list and detail remain inside that recreated subtree; detail is not outside the ScrollYView.

evidence_limits: Read-only review; reviewer did not operate the device or author/edit app source.
Behavior credit is limited to captured reports/tool traces; screenshot appearance alone does not prove interaction correctness.
A geometry pass is not blanket 44pt touch-target, accessibility, stability or full-product acceptance.
Exported L0 settled:true is distinct from native studio.inspect settled:false snapshots.
Fixtures and in-memory state do not establish real mail/calendar/news/finance services, media playback, account sync or persistent storage.
The Mail keyboard-android.png was captured after IME dismissal; the typed-value/scroll/send trace is the keyboard-behavior evidence.
Manual scores assess this collection only, not general DeepSeek superiority or a controlled model benchmark.
